reuse.why: All four steps extend the existing getBulkBudgetCategories selection and reuse averageToBudget, getSheetValue, setBudget, batchMessages and the shared extractTagsFromText tag parser.

duplication.why: Each exclusion rule (hidden, #fixed group, saved template, income outside tracking) is written once in the shared selection; the new action adds no copied selection or sign logic.

placement.why: Rules live in the bulk-action selection in budget/actions.ts and the new method is registered next to its siblings in budget/app.ts.

scope.why: Focused on the requested steps, apart from an unrelated import reorder in schedules/app.ts.

maintainability.why: A single, documented selection function with explicit options that every month-wide action calls makes future rule changes one-place edits.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every month-wide action, including setLastMonthSpending, obtains its categories from getBulkBudgetCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the per-action differences are only the existing skipMissingGroup option.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories: includeHidden is replaced by includeHiddenCategories (no net new parameter); the #fixed and template checks are uniform rules for all callers, not caller-specific branches.
